descriptions: Longitudinal research, relating school career of pupils in secondary education to school capability and social class. Following pupils in final grade of primary education and their school career during secondary education / differentiation of pupils by educational and social level of parents/ capacity score attained at primary school/ advice of headmaster/ actual choice of school type in secondary education/ results of up to nine years of secondary education ( qualifications ). Background variables: basic characteristics/ education/ social class
